recipe.title: Crystal Tide
recipe.tagline: A prism observatory suspended above a frozen electric sea.
recipe.themeSummary: Broken crystal chambers and arched galleries guard an observatory core. Violet crystal shelves flank hazardous luminous shallows.

rooms.name: Prism Landing
rooms.description: Crystal shelves interrupt the violet shallows.

rooms.name: Refraction Gallery
rooms.description: Arched buttresses hold a cracked observatory aloft.

rooms.name: Prism Heart
rooms.description: The Guardian stands watch over the final crystal lens.

lore.title: Tide gauge, cracked
lore.source: scratched into the glass of a brass tide gauge
lore.text: Hour 1: two fingers over the low mark. Hour 6: the glass is warm. Hour 14: it is not water, whatever they say in the gallery, water does not look back. I have stopped marking the hours and started marking the faces.

lore.title: Observatory roster
lore.source: a duty roster pinned under a crystal shelf
lore.text: Forty-one names, each with a small lens sigil, each with a watch assigned. Thirty-eight are struck through in the same violet ink the shallows glow with. The three untouched names all share one shift: the night the lens was first turned downward.

lore.title: Prayer to the Focus
lore.source: etched around the rim of a cracked lens-plate
lore.text: Turn your face to the lens and be counted. Be seen and be kept. The sea only takes what refuses to be seen, and we have refused nothing, so why is the gallery quiet, and why does my watch-partner answer in the wrong voice.

lore.title: Lens-keeper’s last entry
lore.source: a logbook wedged beneath the Anchor pedestal
lore.text: I have stopped the lens. Whatever it was showing the sea, the sea was learning, and it had nearly learned enough to show it back. The observatory core will hold as long as something is planted here that the sea cannot count. Tell no one where the Anchor sits.

lore.title: Surveyor’s badge
lore.source: a crystal badge, still warm from the volley
lore.text: The etching reads Sentinel, Second Watch, with a tally of tides counted underneath. Whoever wore it was posted to count the sea, not to shoot at it. The last tally mark is scratched so hard it went through the crystal.

lore.title: Diver’s tether
lore.source: frayed tether cable and a mouthful of violet salt
lore.text: Divers went down to read the sea up close, on lines like this one, and reported back in words that grew shorter every trip. The final reports are single syllables. The cable is chewed through from the diver’s end.

lore.title: The Focus itself
lore.source: six lens-plates that fell away from a body
lore.text: It was never a person. It was the observatory’s own eye, the great lens given something to stand with, and it did not want to be blinded a second time. Through the plates, faintly, the sea is still trying to show you something.

attunements.name: Counted by the Lens
attunements.description: Turn your face to the lens and be kept: the sea’s bolts find less of you.

attunements.name: Salt-Sure Footing
attunements.description: The divers’ trick for the shallows: what glows underfoot burns a watcher less.

attunements.name: Tide-Gauge Reading
attunements.description: Each mark read from the glass steadies the hand that reads it.

attunements.name: Lens-Keeper’s Stop
attunements.description: You know where the Focus was blinded once. Strike there.
